description: React component for managing team members dropdown menu in Mattermost, including role changes, removal, and demotion modals.

classes.name: TeamMembersDropdown
classes.description: React component for displaying and managing a dropdown menu for team member actions such as role changes, removal, and demotion.

methods.name: handleMakeMember
methods.description: Handles promoting a user to a team member or demoting if the current user is the same and a system admin.

methods.name: handleRemoveFromTeam
methods.description: Handles removing a user from the team.

methods.name: handleMakeAdmin
methods.description: Handles promoting a user to a team admin or demoting if the current user is the same and a system admin.

methods.name: handleDemote
methods.description: Prepares state to show demotion confirmation modal.

methods.name: handleDemoteCancel
methods.description: Cancels the demotion process and hides the modal.

methods.name: handleDemoteSubmit
methods.description: Submits the demotion action and updates user info.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the dropdown menu with options based on user roles and state, including modals.
